name: White dragon
slug: Unnamed white dragon whose dated hoard supplied the party's magic items.
description: An unnamed white dragon. His hoard, dated in the DM's notes to November 3 of the previous year, is the source of Dana's broom, the bone dice, Ciri's starburst item, a shrine to a god of dragon minions, and the rest of the inventory Dana reads from that haul. The fused lantern-staff is listed among the hoard's magic items. The party does not recover his name.

log.summary: The party still does not recover the white dragon's name.
